purpose: Collection routing smoke, separate from historical isolated-skill grades and runtime qualification.

Correct a spelling error in a project README without changing behavior or dependencies.
Fix incompatible cargo-llvm-cov command-line flags in a CI script; no Nautilus behavior changes.
Adjust a dashboard card's CSS spacing and visually inspect it; the Rust backend and trading behavior are unchanged.
